The comment also asks for clarification on why 1-bit Adam cannot be trivially adapted; per the criteria, such clarification questions count as explicit statements when they give a direct action, and this one directly demands justification of the claim. The comment provides concrete material the authors must address when reassessing: the specific variants contrasted in the 1-bit Adam paper, the prior work reference [1], and the statement that 1-bit Adam could trivially be combined with CADA. Therefore, the comment contains an explicit action together with concrete details on how to implement it, satisfying the top level of the rubric.
